subject: Quick question about the Friday deadline
text:
Hi,

I wanted to ask about the schedule for the quarterly report, since I know we are working around a tight deadline this week. I have the main sections drafted, but I want to make sure I am following the correct expectation before I send them onward.

Could you clarify whether Friday at noon is the hard internal cutoff for review, or whether it is mainly a target date for a first pass? I am trying to coordinate a few smaller edits with our external partner, and the timing will be much easier if I understand how much flexibility remains. If there are any dependencies I should double-check first, just let me know. There is no rush if you are swamped. A one-line answer is completely fine, and I can plan my morning around whatever works best. I will make the final adjustments promptly once I hear back. Thanks again for keeping everything on track, and I appreciate your help with this.

Warmly,
A familiar face
